- All Git operations must be executed inside the relevant submodule directory (`src/backend` or `src/frontend`); the root meta-repo does not reflect submodule changes.
- Each product follows a mirrored naming convention: backend directories end in `-ws` (Web Service) or `-mc` (Medical Center), matched by identical names under `src/frontend/`.
- User-facing strings must be wrapped in translation functions (`..%Trans()` in ObjectScript, `$trans()` in JS); bare Chinese literals are prohibited in new/refactored code.
- Frontend requests go through the shared `$.req`/`$.cm` helpers (not raw `$.ajax` or `fetch`), and cacheable dictionary/config data should use `_cache`/`_cacheTTL` parameters.
- Backend classes inherit from `DHCDoc.Util.RegisteredObject`, use PascalCase class names, camelCase methods, and return typed `%DynamicObject`/`%DynamicArray` values.
- Public shared code lives in `src/backend/public-mc/` and `src/frontend/public-mc/` and is consumed by all products; modifications require impact analysis before committing.
